GPT-5.feature: OpenAI's most capable general-purpose model, featuring major improvements in reasoning, instruction following, and code quality. With a 400K token context window and a balanced $1.25/$10.00 input/output price, it excels at complex multi-step problems requiring high accuracy — particularly strong in mathematics, scientific reasoning, and structured problem-solving.

Claude-Sonnet-4.5.feature: Anthropic's most advanced Sonnet-class model, optimised for real-world agentic and coding workflows. Supports a 1M token context window with a $3.00/$15.00 price, and offers strong multi-step reasoning, improved tool orchestration, and context-aware memory management — well-suited for long-horizon math problems requiring sustained logical chains.

Gemini-3.5-Flash.feature: Google's high-efficiency multimodal model released May 2026, bringing near-Pro level coding and reasoning at Flash-tier speed with a 1M token context window, priced at $1.50/$9.00. Optimised for coding proficiency and parallel agentic execution loops, it supports configurable thinking levels (minimal, low, medium, high) for fine-grained cost/performance trade-offs — a strong choice for competition-level math benchmarks where speed and cost efficiency matter.

DeepSeek-R1.feature: A 671B parameter open-source mixture-of-experts reasoning model with fully transparent chain-of-thought tokens, priced at $0.70/$2.50. Performance on par with frontier closed models on math and logic benchmarks (AIME, MATH-500), with 37B active parameters per inference pass — an excellent cost-performance choice for heavy mathematical reasoning.

Qwen3-235B-Thinking.feature: Alibaba's flagship mixture-of-experts thinking model with 235B total and 22B active parameters, supporting a 262K token context window at an extremely competitive $0.455/$1.82 price. Features a native 'thinking mode' with extended chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving top-tier results on math Olympiad benchmarks — ideal for complex multi-step derivations at low cost.

Llama-3.1-70B.feature: Meta's instruction-tuned 70B model from the Llama 3.1 family, with a 131K token context window and symmetric $0.40/$0.40 pricing. Optimised for high-quality dialogue and tool-use workflows across multiple languages, this model offers a strong performance-to-cost ratio for moderately difficult reasoning and general-purpose tasks.

Mixtral-8x22B.feature: Mistral's official instruct fine-tune of the Mixtral 8x22B mixture-of-experts model, using 39B active parameters out of 141B total with a 64K token context window, priced at $0.90/$0.90. It offers substantially stronger math, coding, and multilingual reasoning than its 8x7B predecessor, while remaining cost-effective relative to frontier-class models — a strong mid-tier choice for competition-level problem solving.
